answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to stake a time-locked bond and continuously attest from one unclonable hardware module installed at a unique surveyed knoll. Auditors refract those attestations through a prism of GPS, TPM quotes, and spend history; clones fail because one module cannot occupy two sites. Cheap textual camouflage, even a polished sonnet of required words, does not split the hardware cost.
